name: Furniture Factory
description: Ryttylä has made furniture for a hundred years. The factory's wooden tower was an air-raid lookout during the war.
greeting: Rows of half-finished chairs wait for their legs.

hello: Hands where I can see them. Near the saw, I mean.
We've got an order of two hundred chairs. Get to it.
work: Decent shift. All fingers accounted for?
Good work. Coffee break at nine sharp.
Not bad. My father would've been faster.
firewood: There's always more wood. Cash at the end.
Stack it neatly, this isn't Sweden.
hired: You're on the crew. Don't touch the big saw yet.
matti: Matti's my best man. Don't tell him, he'll ask for a raise. No, he won't. That's Matti.
If everyone worked like Matti, we'd run out of trees.
Thirty-one years and never a sick day. I don't trust it.
refuse: Not like that. Not in my factory.

requires.message: You are not in shape for heavy work.

effects.message: Your arms ache, but your wallet is a bit heavier.

actions.label: Coffee break with Matti
actions.description: Matti has worked here for thirty-one years and still whistles on his way in. His good mood is contagious.

requires.message: Matti is back at work. "Breaks are earned, friend!" Come back next week.

do.message: Matti: "Honest work, honest pay and coffee from a thermos. What more does a man need?"
Matti: "Monday is just Friday's little brother!" He means it, every word.
Matti pours you coffee. "Things are always looking up. Unless you're on the roof, then look down."
Matti shows you photos of his grandchildren, his boat and a very straight stack of planks he is proud of.
